title: Alkahest
description: The alchemists' universal solvent, which would dissolve anything. Distilled at last from all of Chemistry at once. Unlocks the Alkahest Still.

puzzle.goal: A substance of standard potential U is present at activity a, at temperature T. Write how much free energy μ each mole of it carries, with the gas constant R.
puzzle.name: Chemical potential
puzzle.ask: Find μ in J/mol for U = @{U} J/mol, R = 8.314, T = @{T} K and a = @{a}.
puzzle.method: The free energy of mixing per mole is RT ln a; at a = 1 only the standard part is left.
